paragraphs.text: The diary of Thomas Reid, who kept the lighthouse on Skerry Rock from 1861 to 1889, was found in an attic in 2019. Reid recorded the weather every morning at 6 am and noted each ship that passed. Historians have used his notes to show that storms in the area were more frequent in the 1870s than at any time since.
paragraphs.label: A

items.quote: Reid recorded the weather every morning at 6 am
items.prompt: At what time did Reid record the weather each day?

explanation.en: “recorded the weather every morning at 6 am” → 6 am. “At what time” asks for a time, not a year: 1861 and 2019 are other kinds of date.
explanation.kk: «recorded the weather every morning at 6 am» → 6 am. «At what time» сұрағы жылды емес, уақытты сұрайды: 1861 мен 2019 — басқа даталар.
explanation.ru: «recorded the weather every morning at 6 am» → 6 am. Вопрос «At what time» требует время, а не год: 1861 и 2019 — даты другого рода.

items.quote: storms in the area were more frequent in the 1870s than at any time since
items.prompt: In which decade were storms in the area most frequent?

explanation.en: “storms … were more frequent in the 1870s than at any time since” → 1870s. “Decade” means ten years, so not 1861 or 1889.
explanation.kk: «storms … were more frequent in the 1870s than at any time since» → 1870s. «Decade» — онжылдық, сондықтан 1861 де, 1889 да емес.
explanation.ru: «storms … were more frequent in the 1870s than at any time since» → 1870s. «Decade» — десятилетие, поэтому не 1861 и не 1889.

groups.instruction: Questions 1–2. Answer the questions below. Choose NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER from the passage for each answer.

steps.en: Limit: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER. “At what time” asks for a time of day.
steps.kk: Шек: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER. «At what time» — тәулік уақыты керек.
steps.ru: Лимит: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER. «At what time» — нужно время суток.

steps.en: The keywords “record the weather” are in the second sentence: “Reid recorded the weather every morning at 6 am”.
steps.kk: «record the weather» тірек сөздерін екінші сөйлемнен табамыз: «Reid recorded the weather every morning at 6 am».
steps.ru: Ключевые слова «record the weather» находим во втором предложении: «Reid recorded the weather every morning at 6 am».

steps.en: Answer: 6 am. No need for “every morning” — the question already says “each day”.
steps.kk: Жауап: 6 am. «Every morning» қайталаудың керегі жоқ — сұрақта «each day» бар.
steps.ru: Ответ: 6 am. «Every morning» повторять не нужно — вопрос уже говорит «each day».

steps.en: “In which decade” asks for a ten-year period, like 1990s.
steps.ru: «In which decade» — нужен десяток лет, например 1990s.

steps.en: The text has several dates — 1861, 1889, 2019 and 1870s — but only one decade: 1870s.
steps.kk: Мәтінде бірнеше дата бар: 1861, 1889, 2019 және 1870s. Онжылдық біреу ғана — 1870s.
steps.ru: В тексте три даты: 1861, 1889, 2019 и 1870s. Десятилетие только одно — 1870s.

steps.en: Answer: 1870s (“the 1870s” is also accepted — one word and a number).
steps.kk: Жауап: 1870s (the 1870s да есептеледі — бір сөз және сан).
steps.ru: Ответ: 1870s (засчитывается и the 1870s — одно слово и число).
